caveat: SWEEP heuristics are naive: duplicate_content matches only the first 128 bytes of a file (false positives on shared headers/boilerplate/empty files); unused_import and unreferenced_file use regex/name presence checks, not real AST/import-graph analysis. Human review required before deleting anything — do not incinerate on this list alone.
